verses.text: Those who trust the Lord are like Mount Zion, which sits unmoved forever.
As the mountains surround Jerusalem, the Lord surrounds his people now and forever.
The wicked will not rule over those who do right. If they did, the people who do right might use their power to do evil.
Lord , be good to those who are good, whose hearts are honest.
But, Lord , when you remove those who do evil, also remove those who stop following you. Let there be peace in Israel.
